statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Diagnoses I49.5 and I49.9 were listed on the claim
A 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The purpose was to characterize rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings
The claim was denied under CO-22
